mainEntity.name: What does a crypto PR consultant actually do?

acceptedAnswer.text: A crypto PR consultant owns your media strategy end to end: positioning, journalist outreach, pitch writing, embargo management, KOL coordination and coverage tracking. The defining difference from an agency is that the senior person you hire is the person who pitches. There is no account exec layer. Shilika Jain runs this as a fractional engagement, which means you get a Head-of-Comms scope for $5K–$12K/month. For more on how the model works, see what is fractional PR.

mainEntity.name: How much does a crypto PR consultant cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A fractional senior crypto PR consultant typically runs $5K–$12K/month, covering strategy, pitching, editorial relationships and reporting. A launch sprint, where the consultant goes heads-down on a single event such as a TGE, mainnet or raise announcement, is priced at $15K–$40K for a four-to-eight-week engagement. Full-service agencies charge $15K–$45K/month because the retainer funds a multi-person account team. The fractional model removes that markup while keeping the senior scope.

mainEntity.name: Which outlets can a crypto PR consultant realistically place?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tier-1 crypto outlets: CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, The Block, Decrypt, Blockworks, The Defiant. Mainstream where the angle is strong enough: Forbes, Bloomberg, Yahoo Finance, Benzinga. Regional: BloomingBit and TokenPost (Korea), CoinPost and CryptoTimes JP (Japan), ChainCatcher and Jinse (China), Inc42 (India), e27 (SEA). Placements are earned through real news hooks and existing editorial relationships, not wire distribution. See the Web3 PR campaigns service page for the full outlet map.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to get results?

acceptedAnswer.text: The first tier-1 placement typically lands within two to four weeks of the engagement starting, assuming a real news hook exists. Positioning and narrative work happens in week one. Journalist outreach goes in week two. Embargo placements can go live simultaneously on a single date. Sustained coverage, where the project becomes a regular quoted source on its beat, builds over months two and three. The fastest results come when the consultant is engaged four to eight weeks before a public moment.
